message:
VAT is now 25% in the code, and the test suite passes (2/2).

- **`src/vat.js`**: the multiplier changed from `1.2` to `1.25`, and the comment now says 25%.
- **`test/vat.test.js`**: I updated the expected values to match the new rate:
  - 1000 → 1250 (was 1200)
  - 250 → 313 (was 300; 312.5 rounds half up to 313)
  - 999 → 1249 (was 1199)

The test name changed from "adds 20% VAT" to "adds 25% VAT". There was no other VAT reference in the repo (no README or docs), so nothing else needed updating. I haven't committed the changes.
